name: Dynamic Home
description: Dynamic, permission-aware home recommendations for Jellyfin.
overview: Configurable and personalized sections for the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Adds the self-installing browser client. Dynamic Home now renders its complete home experience after a normal catalog installation and restart without a separately patched Jellyfin Web build.
Initial public catalog release with configurable sections, favorites, seasonal recommendations, surprise selection and per-user ordering.
